checklist.detail: Title: 'Platform Foundation & Authentication'. Description: 213 chars, explains what (scaffold, auth, product catalogue) and why (foundation for all sprints). Includes deployment milestone: 'At sprint end: a working app where users can register, login, and see the product catalogue.'

scope_in: 8 items (app scaffold, design system, API scaffold, auth, product catalogue, BridgeNow config, product tag, CI pipeline). scope_out: 4 items (application form, DE, disbursement, back office).

checklist.check: Epic has features with sufficient detail
checklist.detail: 4 features (F-01.1 to F-01.4). All have ID, title, description >100 chars. F-01.1: 340 chars with specific tokens, components, frameworks. F-01.2: 380 chars with architecture layers, middleware, CI. F-01.3: 290 chars with OTP params, JWT config, storage. F-01.4: 350 chars with product params, screens, APIs.

All 14 stories follow 'As a {role}, I want {capability}, so that {benefit}'. Roles used: system administrator (US-001,003,004,009,013), loan applicant (US-002,005,006,007,008,010,011,012,014), operations agent (none in EP-01).
All 14 stories have 3-4 ACs each (total 51 ACs). All in Given/When/Then format. Specific values used (e.g., '6-digit OTP', '90 seconds', 'SAR 4,000', '27% p.a.').

All 14 classified: Public (US-002,010,011,012), Internal (US-001,003,004,009,013), Confidential (US-005,006), Restricted (US-007,008,014). Classification follows data handled: tokens=Restricted, PII=Confidential, config=Internal, product info=Public.
All 14 stories: change_type='new'. Correct for greenfield mode.
Epic covers FR-01, FR-13, FR-20, FR-31, NFR-01, NFR-02 (6 requirements). Features map: F-01.1→FR-02, F-01.2→(infra, no direct FR), F-01.3→FR-20, F-01.4→FR-01,FR-02,FR-13,FR-31.
N/A — greenfield mode. All stories have existing_context with null values. No existing features referenced.
N/A — greenfield mode. All stories have regression_criteria=[] (empty). Correct — nothing exists to regress.

reasoning: EP-01 passes all 10 validation checks. Mode is greenfield — all stories are new, no baseline exists. The epic is well-structured as a foundation sprint: design system (F-01.1) unblocks all UI work, API scaffold (F-01.2) unblocks all backend work, auth (F-01.3) is required by every subsequent feature, and product catalogue (F-01.4) gives a deployable v0.1. 14 stories with 57 total points is appropriate for a 2-week sprint with a team of 4-5 developers. All stories have specific ACs with measurable values (OTP params, JWT expiry, product amounts). Data sensitivity correctly classified — Restricted for tokens/biometric, Confidential for PII, Internal for config, Public for product info. Domain terms (BridgeNow, Tawarruq, SAMA) used correctly per domain glossary.
